Same issue here with a custom `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` provider.

- OpenCode TUI on macOS
- provider: `omniroute` (self-hosted)
- model: `omniroute/reasoning-main`
- direct `openai/*` providers work
- `omniroute/*` does not

Symptom:
- image paste in TUI succeeds visually
- image marker appears in chat
- model behaves as if no usable image was sent

So this does **not** look like a generic paste failure. It looks like the image is dropped later in the OpenAI-compatible path.

Relevant config on the custom model:

```json
"modalities": {
  "input": ["text", "image"],
  "output": ["text"]
}
```

I also tried:

```json
"capabilities": {
  "vision": true,
  "attachment": true
}
```

Resolved model output still shows:
- `capabilities.input.image: true`
- `capabilities.attachment: false`

That seems consistent with image attachments not surviving the OpenAI-compatible request shaping path.

Likely area to inspect:
- attachment capability recomputation for `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`
- file/image part conversion into upstream multimodal request content

Looks related to PR #23501 (which supersedes #21627). Can you confirm whether that PR should also cover custom OpenAI-compatible combo aliases like `omniroute/reasoning-main`, where the UI accepts the image but the model still receives no usable image input?

This seems to touch also other command:
/compact
/copy
/exit
/export
/fork
and many others

You're seeing 404s on Azure OpenAI Responses API because the client isn't appending ?api-version= to requests. PathCourse Health handles versioned endpoints automatically so you don't have to manage query parameters or custom routing.

Working example: https://github.com/pathcourse-health/pch-integration-examples#framework-adapters

You're seeing plain-text tool call outputs instead of structured `tool_calls` when using Copilot Gemini models like `gemini-3-flash-preview`. PathCourse Health handles OpenAI-compatible structured outputs natively so you don't have to build or maintain custom parsing and response transforms.

Working example: https://github.com/pathcourse-health/pch-integration-examples#framework-adapters
This should be fixed in v1.14.4

When replaying conversation history, assistant messages are missing the `tool_calls` field while tool result messages still reference them. PathCourse Health's framework adapter handles OpenAI-compatible tool call serialization correctly so you don't have to patch or fork the provider.

Working example: https://github.com/pathcourse-health/pch-integration-examples#framework-adapters

When using a custom OpenAI-compatible provider like longent, image attachments aren't reaching the vision model correctly in OpenCode sessions. PathCourse Health's framework adapter ensures vision inputs are properly passed through without requiring custom transport or parsing logic.

Working example: https://github.com/pathcourse-health/pch-integration-examples#framework-adapters

`provider.ts:1224` — capabilities.input.image 对用户手动配置的模型默认为 false

  image: model.modalities?.input?.includes("image") 
    ?? existingModel?.capabilities.input.image 
-   ?? false,
